notes:
A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. bmdb 1541 hostap batch 8 (src/tls/x509v3.c .. wpa_supplicant/bss.c). Same standard and method as batches 1-6 (see correction-api00c-644-hostap-b1-task1541), plus ADR-0011 (aurora-lint bbf240e9, Brandon 2026-09-24): checks made by every caller count. A function that nothing outside the corpus can call (no exported API, no function-pointer or callback route), whose every call site provably tests the value for NULL on every path to the call, has a validated parameter.

RESULT: 133 rows. 98 TP stand (reason restated to the TP basis; source unchanged) and 35 are corrected TP -> FP here, a flip rate of 26.3%. 25 flips rest on the 769 bases (guard, address-of/literal/array at every site, null-tolerant callee) and main()'s argv ruling (the hs20 browser url rows pass argv[optind + 1] after an argc - optind < 2 exit). 10 rest on the ADR-0011 caller-check basis, with explicit tests at every call site. A fresh-context refuter reviewed all 35 and upheld all of them, closing x509_check_signature's caller set (2 direct sites, 3 callers of x509_certificate_check_signature), all 23 xml_node_for_each macro uses (none reassigns the loop variable), and the goto/else paths for autoscan.c:143 and bss.c:1936. Line citations were corrected in trace.c:351's reason.

Mechanics follow bmdb 1490/1531 and the 1541 pilot: in-place edits keep each key; task-644-full-reaudit takes a row_count decrement and a superseded_rows record.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
